title: Findings rollup view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from traust-core's findings-rollup view: disposition-aware finding counts for a scope (named products and teams, else every repository) at a point in time, per product, per repository and per category label, with the open critical and high findings listed. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Every serialized field is present, nullable ones included. JSON Schema checks structure and ranges, not count arithmetic.

as_of.description: The point in time the scope was read at; null means current recorded state when the view was built.

total.description: Every finding in scope counted once, including a finding in a repository that several products ship.

products.description: One row per product the filter names, by slug. Empty when no product is named. A finding in a repository several products ship counts under each, so product rows can sum to more than total.

repositories.description: One row per repository in scope, by URL, including repositories with no findings.

top.description: Every open critical or high finding in scope, critical first, then highest CVSS score (unscored last), then repository URL. Empty when none is open.

categories.description: Every finding in scope counted per category label, most findings first; findings without a category label form the group whose key is null.

attack_scenarios.description: The latest threat models' attack scenarios for the repositories in scope, verbatim. Populated only when the filter names products or teams; empty otherwise.

severity_counts.description: Counts by effective severity; unrated counts findings with no severity. Every key is always present.

tally.description: Disposition-aware counts. Only open is exposure; hardening, resolved, risk_accepted and false_positive say why a finding is not.

hardening.description: Defense-in-depth gaps with no demonstrated exploit path.

unverified.description: Open findings with no verdict yet or only a claimed one.

decided.description: Findings with at least one recorded decision, in any state.

tracked.description: Findings that are not false positives: open (all severities) + hardening + resolved + risk_accepted.

repository_url.description: Raw registered URL, preserved as data.

hardening_categories.description: Hardening findings per category label, by label; uncategorized for findings without one. Only categories with at least one hardening finding appear.

title.description: Raw untrusted finding title, preserved as data rather than authored Markdown or HTML.

cvss_score.description: CVSS base score from 0 to 10 as an exact decimal string (for example "9.8"); the scale can vary by storage backend ("7.5" and "7.5000000000" are the same score), so compare as decimals. Null when the finding is unscored.

sla_due.description: When the finding's SLA falls due; null when no SLA deadline applies.

key.description: The category label, raw; null groups the findings without one.

findings.description: Every finding in the group, false positives included.

open_by_severity.description: Open findings by effective severity. The five rated keys are always present; unrated appears only when at least one open finding has no severity.

attack_scenario.description: One threat's attack narrative from a repository's latest threat model, verbatim.

label.description: The section-4 threat id the scenario narrates (for example T3), raw.

threat.description: The scenario's threat name, raw; null when the threat model gives none.

steps.description: Raw untrusted narrative steps, in order, preserved as data.
